title: Reuse key rekeys only what builds against a moved dependency pin

installed_sdk.rationale: This changes only the CI reuse key code, its documentation, and its tests; no SDK header, target, symbol, or installed artifact changes.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No timeline CLI command, flag, or output contract changes.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP operation, schema, or handler changes.

live_product_control.rationale: No runtime operation, executor binding, grant, or profile policy changes.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: The change governs CI test selection and does not publish a design-time capability.
